children: By Tim Hanrahan and Philip Wegmann

President Trump spent the early hours of election night criticizing Fox News. He said he was watching the network, but turned it off because he didn't like the voice of one of the hosts of "The Five," Jessica Tarlov, a regular critic of the president.

"I'll be back later!" he wrote on Truth Social. The president texted Greg Gutfeld, another host of the program, to complain directly about Tarlov. Gutfeld, who read the correspondence live on the air, said the president wrote that inflation would be coming down soon and nuclear weapons wouldn't be used against Iran. Tarlov replied, "Just press, 'stop,'" referring to the way people unsubscribe from unwanted mass text messages.

About an hour later, Trump wrote on Truth Social that Fox News polling is unfair. In a subsequent social-media post, he argued that the network's ratings were down "because they're spending too much time covering the Trump Deranged Dumocrats!" Fox News parent Fox Corp. and The Wall Street Journal parent News Corp share common ownership.
